tr.td: learns badly: the first MoE layers balance poorly or their routing collapses. blows up: an image-generation MoE diverged without its leading dense layers. slow: an MoE in every layer means more all-to-alls.
Aux loss (--moe-per-layer-logging) and MaxVio (routing trace, A.1) in the first MoE layers after the dense block.
slow: the all-to-all is not hidden behind compute.
How much of the all-to-all is exposed: in an nsys timeline (3.7 Profiling), compare the all-to-all kernels on the side stream with the compute on the main stream.
